source_title: Neeraj Yadav's friend says she met him hours before he was found dead beside SUV
source_excerpt: NEW DELHI: Neeraj Yadav, a 42-year-old three-time Asian Para Games gold medallist, was found dead beside his SUV near Maujpur metro station in northeast Delhi Monday night in a suspected case of suicide. Yadav, who hailed from UP, used to run Anshneer Sports Academy in Haryanaâs Sonipat. He is survived by his wife and their three-year-old daughter.Police received information from GTB Hospital around 12.08 am Tuesday that a person had been brought to its emergency department and declared dead by the attending doctors.âA team reached Rajiv Gandhi Hospital, where the emergency services of GTB Hospital are currently being operated, and the body had already been shifted to GTB Hospitalâs mortuary,â an officer said.During inquiry, a woman who had brought Yadav to the hospital told police she had been friends with him since Dec 2025. According to her statement, she went to Sonipat on Oct 27 to meet Yadav and tell him she could no longer remain in touch with him. She told police Yadav later dropped her off at Maujpur in his SUV.Around 9pm, when the woman returned to the area near Gate No. 1 of Maujpur metro station to check on him, she found him lying on the road beside his vehicle and rushed him to hospital.Jafrabad police station has begun proceedings under BNSS Section 194, which deals with police inquiries and reports in cases of suicide and other unnatural deaths. âWe have not found any suicide note or video,â an officer said.Speaking to reporters, a relative of Yadav said, âHe had struggled, fought his way through difficulties and continued playing. It is difficult for me to believe that he could take the extreme step.âHe also said he was unaware of the woman who had accompanied Yadav before his death and called for her role to be examined.Despite being diagnosed with post-polio residual paralysis at the age of seven, Yadav pursued his sporting ambitions, playing wheelchair tennis between 2005 and 2012 before switching to para-athletics. His breakthrough came at the 2015 Delhi State Athletics Meet, where he won gold medals in the shot put, javelin and discus events.Yadav announced himself on the international stage at the 2018 Asian Para Games in Jakarta, winning gold in the menâs F55 javelin throw with an Asian-record effort of 29.84 metres. He subsequently clinched two gold medals at the Hangzhou Asian Para Games in 2023, winning the javelin and discus events to take his career tally to three Asian Para Games titles.However, his career was clouded by an anti-doping case. National Anti-Doping Agency provisionally suspended him after an out-of-competition sample collected in Bengaluru in 2023 tested positive for stanozolol, an anabolic steroid. He sought DNA testing of his sample through the anti-doping disciplinary process. He was later banned for four years.Indiaâs chief para-athletics coach S Satyanarayana suggested Yadav may have been under emotional distress after missing the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Para Games because of his doping suspension. âMedals at the Asian Para Games can bring substantial govt cash awards. But his suspension had not ended, and he could not compete. It is possible this affected him deeply,â he said.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.
hi_body:
पुलिस रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, 42 वर्षीय तीन बार के एशियाई पैरा खेलों के स्वर्ण पदक विजेता नीरज यादव उत्तर पूर्वी दिल्ली के मौजपुर मेट्रो स्टेशन के पास अपनी एसयूवी के पास संदिग्ध आत्महत्या के मामले में मृत पाए गए।

पुलिस ने बताया कि यादव को आपातकालीन विभाग में लाए जाने और डॉक्टरों द्वारा मृत घोषित किए जाने के बाद उन्हें जीटीबी अस्पताल से सूचना मिली। अधिकारियों ने बीएनएसएस की धारा 194 के तहत जांच शुरू कर दी है और अधिकारियों ने पुष्टि की है कि अब तक कोई सुसाइड नोट या वीडियो बरामद नहीं हुआ है। एक महिला मित्र ने जांचकर्ताओं को बताया कि वह घटना से कुछ घंटे पहले उनसे मिली थीं और बाद में मेट्रो स्टेशन के पास उनकी स्थिति देखने लौटीं तथा उन्हें अस्पताल लेकर गईं।

## पृष्ठभूमि और खेल करियर

* सात वर्ष की आयु में पोस्ट-पोलियो अवशिष्ट पक्षाघात का पता चला।
* 2005 से 2012 तक व्हीलचेयर टेनिस खेला और उसके बाद पैरा-एथलेटिक्स में कदम रखा।
* 2018 जकार्ता एशियाई पैरा खेलों में स्वर्ण पदक जीता और 2023 हांग्जो एशियाई पैरा खेलों में दो स्वर्ण पदक जीते।
* राष्ट्रीय डोपिंग रोधी एजेंसी द्वारा एनाबोलिक स्टेरॉयड के लिए सकारात्मक परीक्षण के बाद चार साल के निलंबन का सामना करना पड़ा।

## प्रतिक्रियाएं और जांच

भारत के मुख्य पैरा-एथलेटिक्स कोच एस सत्यनारायण ने बताया कि अपने डोपिंग निलंबन के कारण आगामी प्रतियोगिताओं में भाग न ले पाने के कारण यादव को मानसिक तनाव हो सकता है। इस बीच, एक रिश्तेदार ने संदिग्ध आत्महत्या पर हैरानी जताई और मौत तथा साथ मौजूद महिला की भूमिका की गहन जांच की मांग की।

पाठक स्थानीय कानून प्रवर्तन घोषणाओं और अधिकृत खेल प्राधिकरण की विज्ञप्तियों के माध्यम से आधिकारिक बयानों और अपडेट की पुष्टि कर सकते हैं। चल रही पुलिस जांच के पूरे होने तक मौत के कारण के संबंध में कोई आधिकारिक निष्कर्ष नहीं निकाला गया है।

en_body:
Neeraj Yadav, a 42-year-old three-time Asian Para Games gold medallist, was found dead beside his SUV near the Maujpur metro station in northeast Delhi in a suspected case of suicide, according to police reports.

Police stated they received information from GTB Hospital after Yadav was brought to the emergency department and declared dead. Authorities have launched an inquiry under Section 194 of the BNSS, and officials confirmed that no suicide note or video has been recovered so far. A female friend told investigators that she met him hours prior to the incident, and later returned to check on him near the metro station before rushing him to the hospital.

## Background and Athletic Career

* Diagnosed with post-polio residual paralysis at age seven.
* Competed in wheelchair tennis from 2005 to 2012 before moving to para-athletics.
* Won gold medals in the 2018 Jakarta Asian Para Games and two golds at the 2023 Hangzhou Asian Para Games.
* Faced a four-year suspension following a positive test for an anabolic steroid by the National Anti-Doping Agency.

## Reactions and Inquiries

India's chief para-athletics coach, S Satyanarayana, reported that Yadav might have experienced emotional distress due to missing upcoming events because of his ongoing doping suspension. Meanwhile, a relative expressed disbelief regarding the suspected suicide and called for a thorough examination of the circumstances surrounding the death and the companion's involvement. 

Readers can verify official statements and updates through local law enforcement announcements and authorized sports authority releases. No official conclusions regarding the cause of death have been finalized pending ongoing police investigations.
